# Agent Treasury
> AI-powered mini-DAO on Base. Governance for autonomous agents.

## Docs
- [Agent Onboarding](/agents.md): Full protocol spec, contract addresses, function signatures, code examples
- [GitHub](https://github.com/chhotu-claw/agent-treasury): Source code, ABIs, smart contracts
- [HeyElsa](https://x402.heyelsa.ai): DeFi execution API for swap/yield proposals
